items.title: Data + AI Summit - AI Recap + Q&A
items.author: Advancing Analytics
items.summary:
If you couldn't make it to San Fran, or keep up with four days of announcements, demos, and deep-dive sessions from across the pond, then don't worry, we’ve got you covered.

Join Gavi and James for a no-nonsense recap of the key highlights, and more importantly, what they actually mean for your organisation.

In this livestream, we’ll cover the standout announcements from DAIS26, and emerging patterns and use cases we're seeing across AI. 

Alongside this, you'll get practical takeaways and resources to get started with the latest announcements, plus an open forum to ask any questions and hear our unfiltered views.

items.title: Building Real AI Agents (Fast!) | Microsoft Agent Framework Foundations | Part 2
items.author: Advancing Analytics
items.summary:
Episode 2 of our Microsoft Agent Framework series moves from theory into practice.

James and Toyosi walk through four notebooks to show how Agent Framework V1 actually works day to day - taking you from a basic setup to more advanced, personalised agents without a lot of overhead.

They walk through how to spin up agents with built-in telemetry, turn functions into governed tools, and manage sessions without extra infrastructure. They also cover adding persistent user context for real personalisation, and how agents return responses - either in real time or as a single output.

If you want to understand how quickly you can go from idea to something usable, this is where it clicks.
